ModMetaData.name: Anooba Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Replaces Mlie.StarWarsAnimalCollection's Anooba art with custom generated art per the 2026-09-11 owner ruling on `art: "improve"` rows: Star Wars-named creatures keep their canon identity (the lean, hyena-like Jawa hunting/guard beast), full regeneration, heavy black outline required.
The donor splits EVERY life stage by gender (separate bodyGraphicData/ femaleGraphicData texPaths, swanimals/Anooba/Anooba_m and Anooba_f) - only one look was generated for this wave, so the SAME new art is wired to BOTH Anooba_m_<facing> and Anooba_f_<facing> rather than leaving females on the old donor look (a spawn would otherwise show the new art only on a ~50% roll - the same alternate-variant gotcha ART_REGEN_WAVE2_WIRE_IN_1 hit on AA_Frostmite). The dessicated-corpse texture (Anooba_Dessicated) stays on donor art. LABEL/ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative paths the donor uses, so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution.
